caption: The first view shows a wooden plank floor with scattered pieces: a white T-shaped block, a flat white rectangle, a green GO sign with a red block, a blue block, and a long white domino row along the upper right. A green domino moves toward the top-right corner while the other objects stay put. A hard cut then replaces the layout with an S-shaped chain of standing red, yellow and green dominoes, each end joined to a short white row. In this second view the left white row stands upright before tilting and falling rightward in a smooth wave. The falling white row reaches the green domino at the junction, and the collapse spreads into the colored chain, toppling the leftmost dominoes up the curve. The rest of the loop and the right white row stay standing as the clip ends mid-propagation.
relations: The green domino moves toward the top-right corner while surrounding scattered blocks remain stationary.
Following the hard cut, the upright left white domino row tilts and falls rightward in a wave.
The falling white row strikes the green domino, initiating a collapse that spreads into the colored chain.
The topple propagates up the curve to the leftmost colored dominoes, leaving the rest standing.
